body:
`go test -race -run TestSignInDoneOnceTheAccountIsBack -count=30 ./internal/provider/` on origin/main 2201b6628 reports a data race in 1 run of 30.

- Write: the test sets the global `catalog.Changed` (`internal/provider/signin_removed_test.go:112`).
- Read: a plugin refresh goroutine left running by an earlier test reads it (`catalog.Touched`, `internal/catalog/live.go:202`, reached through `plugin.tell` at `internal/plugin/host.go:671`).

The test's own work is fine. The problem is that an earlier test's goroutine outlives that test, which breaks the rule that whatever a test starts ends when it does. Found while checking the settings and catalog caching commits; they don't touch this path.
title: provider: TestSignInDoneOnceTheAccountIsBack races a plugin refresh left by an earlier test (catalog.Changed)
